QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Materials for the Experiment 1
QuestInfo.0: #p2154009##k, the Black Wing #bmad scientist at the #b#m310060000##k in the Mine, seems to be conducting a dangerous experiment.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2154009# wants #b#t4032771#s#k for a new experiment. You can't even imagine what he's going to do with them... Head over to the #b#m310050510##k, where the Racaronis can be found.

#i4032771# #t4032771# #b#c4032771#/5#k
QuestInfo.2: #p2154009# let out a vicious laugh as soon as you give him the #t4032771#s. His experiment doesn't seem very pleasant...

0.0: Hehehe... Yes, the experiment is going smoothly. Next, I need... Are you new? I've never seen your face before. Well, I supposed I could have seen you before, but I'm really bad at remembering faces. Human ones, at least.
0.1: Anyway, if you are new, come here and do me a favor. I'm conducting a new experiment and need something. I want you to go get it for me.

yes.0: What I need are #b#t4032771# items#k. I can't prepare them in advance because I need them fresh. If my theory is correct, I'll need #b5#k of them. Thanks.

no.0: What? You are refusing? Oh well... There are plenty of others who can do it.

1.0: Have you brought the 5 #t4032771#s? Good, I will start the experiment now.

0.msg: Creating a stronger model by exploding the energy within a heart, like the one in #o8105003#'s booster mode, will...

item.0: Haven't you gotten those #b5 #t4032771# items#k yet? You might not be as strong as you look. I could make you stronger by upgrading you to a #o8105003#... Never mind. #p2154002# told me not to talk about that.
